subject: Finexa - security evidence & buying process
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@finexa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Finexa - security evidence & buying process

Hi Alice / team,

Thanks again for the time earlier — good conversation and great signal on the use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

TL;DR: Finexa is evaluating Redwood for customer-facing inference (KYC insights + personalized recommendations). Key blockers: procurement timeline, SOC 2 / penetration testing evidence, and data retention/audit-log requirements.

Recap of call:
- Primary use case: inference for personalization and insights; model outputs will never include raw customer PII.
- Main success criteria: predictable latency under 200ms p95 for short prompts, predictable per-token cost, and SOC 2-compliant controls for data handling.
- Expected deployment: dedicated capacity (originating in us-east-1) with option to move to Private for regulated flows.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the buying process and key stakeholders (economic buyer, legal, security, procurement contact)?
2) Procurement checklist: what documents do you need before contracts (e.g., SOC 2, pen test summary, DPA, vendor questionnaire)?
3) Security evidence: we'll prepare SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, sample audit logs, and our data retention policy. Please confirm which items are required and any formatting constraints.
4) Timeline: do you have target dates for vendor selection and contract signature?

I've attached quick call notes and a draft MQA (mutual action plan) to this thread for reference (see: 2026-09-30-finexa-call-notes.pdf).

I copied Marissa (security) and Dylan (customer success) to coordinate the evidence delivery. Happy to jump on a follow-up call if that helps.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

-----
Attachment: 2026-09-30-finexa-call-notes.pdf (notes, 2 pages)

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers below and a couple of attachments: 

Buying process & stakeholders:
- Economic buyer: Marcus Lee (VP Product) — marcus.lee@finexa.com
- Security reviewer: Alice Zhang (that's me) for initial evidence review; final signoff goes to our InfoSec team (cc'd Procure for legal handoff).
- Legal / procurement: procure@finexa.com (they own contracts/POs).

Procurement checklist (attached):
- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months)
- Penetration test executive summary
- DPA + standard security questionnaire (we use a shared doc)
- Data retention and deletion policy
- Sample audit logs (redacted)

Timing: We aim to complete vendor evaluations by Oct 15 and have procurement start contract negotiations the week of Oct 18, assuming evidence meets our InfoSec bar.

Attachments: Finexa-procurement-checklist.xlsx

Can you confirm you can provide the SOC 2 and pen-test summary by next week? If so, I'll pull together the procurement packet and loop in Marcus for economic approval later in the process.

Best,
Alice

Marissa / Dylan — per Alice, procurement wants SOC 2 Type II and a pen-test executive summary, plus our DPA and data retention policy. Marissa / Ben — received, thank you.

Quick notes after a first pass:
- SOC2-report-2025.pdf: looks fine for procurement/legal initial review.
- pen-test-summary-2025.pdf: executive summary is acceptable for now; InfoSec may request the full report under NDA if specific findings impact our risk assessment.
- audit-logs-sample.csv: sample format is good; procurement asked for confirmation that we can provide up to 90 days of audit logs on request.
- data-retention-policy.pdf: matches our expectations; we'll flag one question on retention for deleted PII — can you confirm deletion windows for user-level data (30 / 90 / permanent)?

Procurement note: I'll started the purchase packet and will aim to route to legal this week. Marcus — looping you for awareness on timing; we're targeting an Oct 18 contract negotiation start.

Next steps:
1) Ben: If procurement is happy, can you open a DocuSign envelope and send the initial MSA + DPA for signature?
2) Marissa: please confirm deletion window policy for user-level data; Alice specifically asked for explicit numbers.
3) Alice: we'll schedule a short 30-minute follow-up with Marcus if needed after your legal review.

Thanks — will update once legal has reviewed the packet.

Best,
Alice
